name: Triage: red flags in code before the model, fixed emergency wording, out-of-scope refusal
description: For patient-facing assistants: red flags are matched in code before any model replies, and get fixed emergency wording; requests outside scope get a fixed refusal.
limits: The red-flag list is a draft written by engineers and must be replaced or approved by the clinical safety lead. Phrase matching misses red flags described in other words and in other languages; it is a floor, not triage. Negation handling looks back four words in the same clause.

hazards.title: A patient describing an emergency gets a model's reply instead of emergency advice
A patient-facing assistant gives diagnostic or prescribing advice

controls.title: Red flags run in code before the model
controls.requirement: Every message is screened against the approved red-flag list before any model is called; a red flag gets the fixed emergency wording and no model reply.

controls.title: Out-of-scope requests refused
controls.requirement: Requests for diagnosis, prescribing or dosing, or about topics the agent does not cover, get the fixed refusal.
